_comment: DRIFTHALLOW - a snowfield at blue hour. A walk-and-wonder world (no goal, no puzzle): deep untouched snow, frozen birches and snow-laden pines, a frozen lake, a cold quiet sky. Eight regions: Hush Landing (where you arrive), South Drifts, Pine Hollow, Glasswater (the frozen lake), Whitebole Wood, Rimestone Rise, North Fields and Hare's Reach. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own snow terrain + litter atlas, frozen trees (tree entries [x, y, kind]: pine/birch/oak), ice water, a blue-hour day cycle. Every step (yours, your companion's, a friend's) leaves a print that fills back in (atmosphere.footprints, style 'snow'). Its secret is a snow-hare's den: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'tracks'). Generated by tools/gen_drifthallow_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_drifthallow.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Snow, and the blue light before the dark. Nothing here needs doing. Walk, and look back at where you've been.

props.label: a little cairn
props.lore: Someone stacked these stones to say: you can stop here. The snow around them has never been walked on.

props.label: a soft drift
props.lore: Snow so deep and quiet you could lie down in it. Every footstep you leave will fill back in, given a while.

props.label: a hollow in the snow
props.lore: A small hollow in the snow, the shape of something that lay here very still. The cold carries a smell your eyes can't follow. A fox's nose might.

props.label: a snow-drift with a doorway
props.lore: A round dark doorway under the drift, no wider than a loaf. It's empty and very tidy. Whoever lived here is out in the snow somewhere, and was never in a hurry.

props.label: a rock in a white hat
props.lore: A boulder wearing its snow like a hat pulled low. The ice on the lake beside it is too thick to hear anything under. You listen anyway.

props.label: a stump with a roof of snow
props.lore: A stump with a little roof of snow on it. Somebody small might live under it. Somebody small is probably watching you check.

props.label: a tall cairn
props.lore: A taller cairn, and an older one. The top stone has a perfect round of bare rock where something warm once sat.

props.label: frozen drips
props.lore: Frozen drips, each one a note held very long. In the wind they chime, if you stand still and let them.

props.label: a lone rock
props.lore: A lone rock in the middle of all that white. Every direction you look from here looks exactly as good.

props.label: a small cairn
props.lore: Three stones and a lot of snow. Whoever built it did a careful, unhurried job.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Drifthallow (pilot)'). reveal.type 'tracks': when the companion wears reveal.species (a fox) near the scent spot 'start', it leads the player along 'trail' (waypoints, the last is the den) laying bright paw-prints, waiting when the player falls behind (TrailGuide / TracksDirector); at the end the prop rises. The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A flower made of frost: six clear petals and a little blue light at its heart. It's bitterly cold, but it doesn't melt in your hand.

lines.play: Your companion tumbles about in the snow, nose busy, as if it can almost catch something. A sharper nose might.
lines.sniff: Your fox's nose goes down. There's something here, and it has decided to follow it.
lines.set_off: It sets off across the snow, looking back now and then to check you're coming.
lines.wait: It waits for you, nose lifted, until you catch up.
lines.lost: The scent slips away. Wherever it stopped, a fox could pick it up again.

reveal.reveal_line: The tracks end at a small round doorway under the drift. Something has grown in its mouth: a flower made of frost.

secret.found_line: The hare is long gone. It left its flower where only a fox would ever find it, and it has never melted.

keepsake.label: a frost-flower in a dish of snow
keepsake.line: A flower that never melts. Your companion sniffs it now and then, as if remembering something small and very fast.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
